answer: Graded work pays from escrow, released only when a quorum signs off. Each dissenting peer dilutes the payout, so buying a yes vote splits the reward instead of increasing it. Vesting then unlocks the balance against future work, not the current epoch. A farm must keep every clone productive through many epochs before it withdraws a token, and pays dilution on every pass, whether the work is a falcon survey or a yarrow harvest on some shale lease.
